Looping in Samantha to confirm whether procurement can expedite the tax check.

• ACH timing: understood — if your bank's 3-business-day lead makes Thursday the earliest, that's OK. Please confirm the exact expected activation date once procurement signs.
• Wire fallback: we can accept a Saturday wire. For security, we'll provide a one-time transfer link (DocSend encrypted link) that contains the full intermediary routing and beneficiary confirmation. If you prefer to use your bank's wire template, here's the intermediary routing to include: [Attachment: INV-3349-remittance-stub.pdf shows beneficiary reference].

Plan recommendation:
1) Procurement validates tax residency by end of day Wednesday.
2) If validated, AP enables ACH and we expect debit Thursday.
3) If validation not complete by Wednesday EOD, AP to send Saturday wire to avoid Friday cutoff. Redwood will mark invoice as paid on receipt and send remittance advice.

Neha — can you prepare an official tax residency letter on Redwood letterhead and share a DocSend link for the wire details? Ben — can you keep exec aware if procurement escalation is required?

Thanks everyone,
